videos.headline: App State holds off Toledo for Camellia Bowl win
videos.description: Marcus Cox rushes for 143 yards and a touchdown to help Appalachian State to a 31-28 win over Toledo in the Raycom Media Camellia Bowl.

videos.headline: Toledo misses game-tying FG in final minute
videos.description: Down 31-28, Jameson Vest's 30-yard field goal goes right and Toledo misses an opportunity to tie the game, allowing Appalachian State to hold on for the win.

videos.headline: App State's Hopkins scores on a sweep
videos.description: Appalachian State's Deltron Hopkins takes the sweep and gets into open space, then lunges for the pylon to score a 16-yard touchdown against Toledo.

videos.headline: Toledo answers with Roberts' 15-yard TD catch
videos.description: Toledo tight end Michael Roberts hauls in his 16th touchdown of the season, a 15-yard score to even the game at 7-7 against Appalachian State.

videos.headline: App State's Cox scurries 13-yards for TD
videos.description: Appalachian State's Marcus Cox takes the handoff toward the far side of the field scoring a 13-yard touchdown in the second quarter against Toledo.

videos.headline: Toledo's Hunt rushes 26 yards to tie the game
videos.description: Toledo running back Kareem Hunt makes a cut into open space and scores a 26-yard touchdown to tie the game against Appalachian State in the second quarter.
